title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-23
lineage: 2 Sources: SBD > MR > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN; SBD > MC > R > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’69 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star > Saint Stephen > The Eleven suite and a blazing Lovelight.
ai_review.review: These reviews rave about a tight, short set that bursts with fire – Jerry’s guitar is on full throttle throughout the Dark Star/​Saint Stephen/​Eleven medley, and Pigpen drives an electrifying Lovelight. The soundboard source is generally praised as crisp and vibrant, with only minor tape‑flutter and a brief source change noted in The Eleven.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating of 4.6 from 18 detailed reviews, with overwhelming praise for both performance and soundboard quality; only occasional minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear overall, but a few reviewers note slight tape flutter, tonal variance, and a source change during The Eleven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short but tightly sequenced show; Dark Star > Saint Stephen > The Eleven flows into a high‑energy Lovelight, with Morning Dew early in the set and a few brief tuning pauses that don’t detract from the overall momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly described as 'on fire', delivering phenomenal guitar tone and an extended creative surge during Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for vulnerable, emotive vocals on 'Me And My Uncle' that add depth to the set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Percussion textures are highlighted as varied and interesting, especially in the later part of Dark Star.
